purpose: Teach: 平坦/絶え間/見切り/感ずる/働きかける/釘付け/呼ばわり/叱り

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、人生は平坦ではないけれど、お父さんがいらしてくれるわ
lines.en: Sho, life isn't always smooth, but your dad will be here with you.
lines.style: Warm, grounded certainty. Steady voice, slightly lower register. A gentle reassurance that sits with him rather than lifts. Soft opening on his name.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんの絶え間ないお手伝いに感謝してるよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I'm really grateful for all the help Dad gives me.
lines.style: Bright, eager clarity. Quick attack on the opening. Real appreciation in his voice — not performing gratitude, feeling it. Slight lift at the end, almost like a small question.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、古いおもちゃに見切りを付けて整理しましょうね
lines.en: Sho, let's go through your old toys together and say goodbye to the ones you've outgrown, okay?
lines.style: Matter-of-fact gentleness. No rush. Practical but warm — this is care disguised as a task. Slight pause after 'okay' to let him settle into it.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんの優しさを心で感ずるよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I can feel how kind Dad really is, deep down.
lines.style: Soft, almost wondering. A six-year-old discovering something true about someone he loves. Slight breathiness, like he's not quite sure how to say it but he needs to try.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんに本を一緒に読もうって働きかける気持ちでね
lines.en: Sho, why don't you ask your dad if he'd like to read a book together? I think he'd love that.
lines.style: Encouraging without pushing. Warm suggestion more than instruction. A small conspiratorial warmth — you know something good will happen if you do this.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんの絵本に釘付けになったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I got so caught up in the picture book Dad was reading, I couldn't look away.
lines.style: Delighted, unselfconscious absorption. Quick energy on 'caught up.' The joy of being lost in a moment with someone. Slight smile in the voice.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お友達を悪呼ばわりしないようにしましょうね
lines.en: Sho, we don't call our friends mean names, do we? Let's use kind words instead.
lines.style: Gentle redirect. Not a reprimand — a quiet reminder of who he is. The 'we' makes it shared, not punishing. Very light touch.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんに叱りつけられず優しく教えてもらったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad didn't yell at me or scold me—he just explained it kindly, so I'd understand.
lines.style: Wonder and relief intertwined. Small voice, but full of sincerity. A child discovering that gentleness is stronger than harshness. Slight trailing-off as if he's still absorbing it.
